card.name: Words just before a restriction or consequence
card.fires_on: Small linking words and nouns that sit right before a clause about what a person should avoid, cannot do, or suffers. Examples are 'no longer', 'without', 'patients' and 'who' after 'individuals'.

modes.label: Negating or linking words
modes.description: Words like 'longer', 'without' or 'after' that lead into a verb phrase about not doing or experiencing something.
modes.example: his eye no<< longer>> revels among the gay variety of colours

modes.label: Patient group before a warning
modes.description: A group noun or 'who' in a contraindication or precaution naming people with an allergy or condition.
modes.example: in those individuals<< who>> have experienced a cephalosporin

modes.label: Other clause-linking words
modes.description: Adverbs or prepositions inside a longer sentence that lead into the next clause.
modes.example: when he is<< suddenly>> blinded by glaring brightness

card.writes: It suppresses words about hiding and suspicion, and mildly promotes Chinese words meaning 'facing' or 'towards'; the overall effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come just before a statement about who is affected or what someone can no longer do.
